title: Sivananda Eminent Citizen Awards
summary: Annual recognition of eminent citizens of society, conferred with a cash award, a citation and a memento at a formal convocation.

title: Sree Ramanavami Prathibha Puraskaram
summary: Felicitation of accomplished individuals on the occasion of Sree Ramanavami, encouraging sustained contribution to culture and scholarship.

title: Sangeetha Vidya Nidhi
summary: A title conferred on musicians in recognition of accomplishment and standing in the Carnatic tradition.

title: Natya Vidya Nidhi
summary: The corresponding title for dancers, recognising mastery of the classical dance tradition.

title: Sarada Sangeetha Puraskaram
summary: An award presented during the Sarada Sangeetotsavam to artists performing in the festival.
